{{Short description|1-dimensional ring with special properties}}
In [[mathematics]], an '''Arf ring''' was defined by {{harvtxt|Lipman|1971}} to be a 1-[[Krull dimension|dimensional]] [[commutative ring|commutative]] [[semi-local ring|semi-local]] [[Cohen–Macaulay ring|Macaulay]] [[ring (mathematics)|ring]] satisfying some extra conditions studied by {{harvs|txt|last=Arf|first=Cahit|authorlink=Cahit Arf|year=1948}}.
